segments.ja: エルミハ区では、馬と人が同じ門に集まっています。ウォール・ローゼの警報で、村から壁の側へ戻る列と、確認へ出る列がすれ違います。すれ違いの速さが、情報の足りなさを見せます。ピクシスは、穴の位置が分かるまで兵を無駄に割らないと言います。言っても、家族のいる方向へ走る兵士は止まりません。止まらないことを、命令だけでは切れません。切れない列が、門の前で二本になります。
segments.en: At Ehrmich District, horses and people gather at the same gate. Under the Wall Rose alarm, the column coming back from the villages toward the wall passes the column going out to check. The speed of that passing shows how little information there is. Pyxis says he will not split soldiers uselessly until the place of the hole is known. Even so, soldiers running toward where their families are do not stop. An order alone cannot cut that. The uncut column becomes two lines in front of the gate.

segments.ja: サシャは、自分の村の方向を隠さずに馬を出します。故郷の森と畑は、巨人の餌場になるには広すぎて、かつ近すぎます。父がいるはずの場所へ、彼女は補給の理屈を後から付けます。理屈は通っています。通っていることの下に、娘として帰りたい速度があります。速度は、同期の隊を少しだけ先行させます。先行を、彼女は申し訳なさで埋めません。埋める暇がありません。暇のなさが、彼女の正直さです。
segments.en: Sasha takes a horse toward her own village without hiding the direction. The forest and fields of her hometown are too wide, and too near, to become a feeding ground. She adds the logic of supplies afterward, onto the place where her father should be. The logic holds. Under what holds, there is the speed of a daughter who wants to return. That speed puts her a little ahead of her classmates' squad. She does not fill the lead with apology. There is no time to fill it. The lack of time is her honesty.

segments.ja: 村の近くで、サシャは父と会います。父は住民を馬で逃がす側にいます。娘の制服を見て、彼は一度だけ目を細め、すぐに次の人の手綱を取ります。再会は短いです。短い再会が、今日は十分なただいまになります。サシャは父の馬の後ろで、遅れた家族を探します。探す仕事は兵士の仕事であり、娘の仕事でもあります。二つの仕事が、同じ道で重なります。重なった道を、父は娘に任せます。
segments.en: Near the village, Sasha meets her father. He is on the side that gets residents away by horse. Seeing his daughter's uniform, he narrows his eyes once and immediately takes the next person's reins. The meeting is short. A short meeting is a sufficient coming-home today. Behind her father's horse, Sasha looks for families who are late. The work of looking is a soldier's work, and it is also a daughter's. The two works overlap on the same road. On that road her father trusts her with the rear.

segments.ja: 逃走の途中で、巨人が一人の住民に追いつきます。サシャは立体機動が足りない場所で、弓を使います。矢は英雄の一撃ではなく、数秒を買う道具です。数秒で、父が別の人を馬に上げます。サシャは自分の怖さを、笑いで隠しません。隠さない怖さが、今日は正確な射手を作ります。村の人は、その正確さを娘の成長として見る暇がありません。見るのは、次の森の出口です。出口の先に、壁の側の光があります。
segments.en: During the flight, a Titan catches up to one resident. Where ODM gear is not enough, Sasha uses a bow. The arrow is not a hero's blow. It is a tool that buys a few seconds. In those seconds her father gets another person onto a horse. Sasha does not hide her fear with a laugh. The fear she does not hide makes an accurate shot today. The village people have no time to see that accuracy as a daughter's growth. What they see is the next exit from the forest. Past the exit is the light on the wall's side.

segments.ja: コニーは別の道で、自分の村へ近づきます。近づく理由を、彼は確認任務だと言います。任務の下に、母と妹の顔があります。顔を思い出す速度が、馬の速度より速いです。ユミルはその速さを、止めずに隣で見ています。止めても、故郷の方向は変わりません。変わらない道の先で、村の音がありません。音が無いことが、最初の異常です。異常を、彼はまだ事故だと思いたがります。
segments.en: On another road, Connie comes near his own village. He says the reason for coming near is a check assignment. Under the assignment are his mother's face and his sister's. The speed of remembering those faces is faster than the horse. Ymir watches that speed from beside him and does not stop it. Even if she stopped it, the direction of a hometown would not change. Ahead on the unchanging road, the village has no sound. The lack of sound is the first abnormality. He still wants to call the abnormality an accident.

segments.ja: 村の入口で、コニーはただいまと言うべき場所を探します。家は壊れるか、無人かです。無人の道に、返事をする窓がありません。返事が無い挨拶は、兵士の報告文には書けません。書けないまま、彼は自分の家の方向へ歩きます。歩く足が、訓練で習った警戒より先に家の習慣を出します。習慣は、今日は武器になりません。武器にならない習慣が、彼の喉に残ります。
segments.en: At the village entrance, Connie looks for the place where a person says they are home. The houses are broken, or empty. On the empty road there is no window to answer. A greeting with no answer cannot be written into a soldier's report. Unable to write it, he walks toward his own house. His feet put the habit of home ahead of the caution he learned in training. Habit is not a weapon today. The habit that is not a weapon stays in his throat.

segments.ja: コニーの家の位置に、動けない巨人がいます。倒れたまま、顔だけが家のほうを向いています。向き方が、襲撃の姿勢ではありません。彼はその顔を、知っている人の骨組みとして見てしまい、すぐにその見方を否定します。否定しても、目はもう比べてしまっています。比べた事実は、口に出せません。ユミルも、その顔の近さを簡単には冗談にしません。冗談が死ぬ場所です。死んだ冗談のあとに、沈黙だけが残ります。
segments.en: Where Connie's house stands, there is a Titan that cannot move. It has fallen, and only its face is turned toward the house. The turn is not the posture of an attack. He sees that face as the frame of someone he knows, and immediately denies the seeing. Even denying it, his eyes have already compared them. The fact of the comparison cannot be said aloud. Ymir also does not easily make a joke of how near that face is. It is a place where jokes die. After the joke dies, only silence remains.

segments.ja: 村がこうなるには、巨人が壁を突破した穴が要るはずです。隊は周辺を見ても、穴を見つけません。見つけない報告が、エルミハと壁の上へ積みます。積むほど、ウォール・ローゼは破られていないように見えます。見えても、村は壊れています。破られていない壁と、壊れた故郷を、同じ地図に置くことが今日の作業です。作業は、理由をまだ持ちません。理由の空欄が、次の隊の命令になります。
segments.en: For a village to become this, there should be a hole where Titans broke the wall. The squad looks around and does not find a hole. Reports of not finding one pile up toward Ehrmich and the top of the wall. The more they pile, the more Wall Rose looks unbroken. Even looking unbroken, the village is destroyed. Putting an unbroken wall and a broken hometown on the same map is today's work. The work does not yet have a reason. The blank reason becomes the next squad's order.

segments.en: Inside the walls, the questions to Nick are still going. Hange sets, in front of the priest's face, the possibility that the wall's material and a Titan's hardening are alike. segments.en: Levi keeps Eren under watch, set outside the confusion in the south. The watch is not a lack of trust. It is management of a body before anyone has a name for what it might do. He does not use the word Coordinate yet. What he uses is a short sentence: do not go out on your own. Eren hears that sentence as the reason he cannot go to the villages. The more he hears it, the more he imagines what his classmates are seeing in their hometowns. Imagination tires faster than a fist. Even tired, he keeps looking south.

segments.en: Ymir does not look at the Titan on Connie's house as an object of pity. Not looking is not coldness. It is because she holds a different memory in a Titan's face. She does not tell the memory today. Instead of telling it, she makes a speed that pulls him away from the front of the house. She calls the reason a continuation of the assignment. The continuation is true. Under the truth is a judgment that this face should not be shown for long. The judgment pushes his shoulder before any explanation.

segments.en: Just before leaving the village, Connie looks at the house once more. If his mother were there, this hour would put her in the kitchen or at the door. Both places are occupied not by a person but by broken timber and a Titan that cannot move. He cannot report that occupation as a confirmed death. Being unable to confirm it is the worst shape of a whereabouts. If he says the worst aloud it might become true, so he goes back to the horse. Going back is the end of today's coming home. The end does not have the shape of a greeting.

vocab.exampleJa: エルミハ区では、馬と人が同じ門に集まっています。
vocab.exampleEn: At Ehrmich District, horses and people gather at the same gate. Under the Wall Rose alarm, the column coming back from the villages toward the wall passes the column going out to check. The speed of that passing shows how little information there is. Pyxis says he will not split soldiers uselessly until the place of the hole is known. Even so, soldiers running toward where their families are do not stop. An order alone cannot cut that. The uncut column becomes two lines in front of the gate.

vocab.exampleJa: 村を確認し終えた兵士は、残った同期と城の方向で落ち合うことになります。
vocab.exampleEn: With the blank still blank, the next squad starts to look southwest. Soldiers who have finished checking villages will meet the classmates who remain, in the direction of a castle. vocab.exampleJa: 父がいるはずの場所へ、彼女は補給の理屈を後から付けます。
vocab.exampleEn: Sasha takes a horse toward her own village without hiding the direction. The forest and fields of her hometown are too wide, and too near, to become a feeding ground. She adds the logic of supplies afterward, onto the place where her father should be. The logic holds. Under what holds, there is the speed of a daughter who wants to return. That speed puts her a little ahead of her classmates' squad. She does not fill the lead with apology. There is no time to fill it. The lack of time is her honesty.

vocab.exampleJa: ユミルはその速さを、止めずに隣で見ています。
vocab.exampleEn: On another road, Connie comes near his own village. He says the reason for coming near is a check assignment. Under the assignment are his mother's face and his sister's. The speed of remembering those faces is faster than the horse. Ymir watches that speed from beside him and does not stop it. Even if she stopped it, the direction of a hometown would not change. Ahead on the unchanging road, the village has no sound. The lack of sound is the first abnormality. He still wants to call the abnormality an accident.
